models.detector_A: YOLOE-11s-seg (ultralytics 8.4.186), text prompts via cached MobileCLIP-BLT embeddings

detector_A.name: YOLOE-11s-seg
detector_A.good: fast on a 4 GB GPU (~0.1-0.3 s), gives masks
detector_A.bad: small model, weak on Indian clutter, invents boxes at low thresholds

detector_B.name: OWLv2 base patch16 ensemble
detector_B.good: different architecture and training data from A, so their agreement means something
detector_B.bad: slower (~1-2 s), boxes only, high recall on vague prompts like 'broken pavement'

footpath_mask.name: SegFormer-B0 sidewalk (malra/segformer-b0-finetuned-segments-sidewalk-4)
footpath_mask.by: NVIDIA SegFormer, fine-tune by malra on segments.ai sidewalk
footpath_mask.licence: base code: NVIDIA SegFormer licence; fine-tune card: no licence field (UNVERIFIED)
footpath_mask.kind: semantic segmentation: footpath vs road vs other
footpath_mask.good: tells if an object sits on the footpath or the carriageway
footpath_mask.bad: trained on Belgian streets; indoor scenes have no footpath class

depth.name: Depth Anything V2 Metric Outdoor Small
depth.bad: outdoor fine-tune: indoor metres are rough; scale depends on focal length guess

reasoner.name: opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash
reasoner.licence: hosted API (model licence not checked tonight: UNVERIFIED)
reasoner.kind: text only: turns detector decisions + the vision description + body table into the element list and a plain answer
reasoner.good: cheap, fast text model; never sees pixels so it cannot hallucinate from the photo
reasoner.bad: can only be as right as its inputs; may over-generalise

vlm.name: opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash
vlm.by: Xiaomi MiMo, served by opencode Go
vlm.licence: hosted API (model licence not checked tonight: UNVERIFIED)
vlm.kind: reads the whole photo + the numbered boxes, names scene, elements, measurements
vlm.good: understands rooms, hallways, steps, lighting, things no detector prompt covers
vlm.bad: can say 'visible' to things that are not there; its measurements are estimates, never ACCEPT on its own
